title: Nvidia’s new open-source vision model predicts bounding boxes 10x #AI #ComputerVision
description: Nvidia has released an open-source computer vision model that achieves speeds up to 10 times faster than existing leading models. Unlike traditional vision models that predict bounding boxes incrementally—corner-by-corner or token-by-token—this new approach employs parallel box decoding, predicting the entire bounding box simultaneously. This innovation significantly accelerates the detection process without compromising accuracy. The model was trained on an extensive dataset, including over 100 million queries and hundreds of millions of bounding boxes, enabling robust performance across varied applications. By making this technology freely accessible on platforms like Hugging Face and GitHub, Nvidia supports wider adoption and development in computer vision tasks, enhancing both research and practical implementations. This advancement stands out for its novel decoding method, scalability, and openness, making it valuable to developers and organizations focused on rapid and precise visual object detection. #Nvidia #ComputerVision #OpenSource #ParallelBoxDecoding #ArtificialIntelligence #MachineLearning #ObjectDetection #VisionModels #DeepLearning #HuggingFace #GitHub #TechnologyInnovation #AIResearch #BoundingBox #FastAI
